q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT P.EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON AS P LEFT JOIN PERSON AS DP ON P.EMAIL = DP.EMAIL WHERE P.ID <> DP.ID

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects emails that appear more than once in the PERSON table, while Q2 identifies distinct pairs of people with the same email address.
